## ObjectStorage

Access to attachments.

### Methods

#### get()

```ts
get(assetId: string): Promise<ArrayBuffer>
```

#### url()

```ts
url(assetId: string, options?: { expiresIn?: number }): Promise<string>
```

Returns a signed URL, valid for `expiresIn` seconds (default 3600).

#### stream()

```ts
stream(assetId: string): Promise<ReadableStream<Uint8Array>>
```

Prefer this over get() for anything larger than a photo: a ReadableStream<Uint8Array> never holds the whole file in memory.
